text: The Stone-Weierstrass theorem generalises Weierstrass's approximation theorem: it says that a subalgebra A of C(X) (continuous functions on compact X) is dense iff A:
choices: separates points and contains a nonzero constant
explanation: Stone-Weierstrass: A dense in C(X) iff A separates points (∀x≠y ∃f∈A: f(x)≠f(y)) and A contains a nonzero constant. Generalises Weierstrass polynomial approximation.
